description: Signed index: verification, ordering (rollback, fork), redirects, identity moves, the invitation listing and its padding.

vectors.name: index-ok
vectors.description: Alice, seq 1, rotation 0: two packs (packs/, media/), public file, invitations listing (1 real token + 3 dummies).

vectors.name: index-ok-no-options
vectors.description: Only the clock: verified for nobody in particular (cannot open packs).

vectors.name: index-ok-bytes
vectors.description: The same index given as UTF-8 bytes.

vectors.name: index-higher-rotation-lower-seq
vectors.description: Rotation 1, seq 1 after rotation 0, seq 2: the rotation orders first.

vectors.name: index-lastseen-anchor
vectors.description: lastSeen given as the anchor of seq 1.

vectors.name: index-minor-extension
vectors.description: minor 1: unknown top-level field and unknown field in a pack entry are ignored (and signed).

vectors.name: index-crit-known
vectors.description: crit lists a known optional field.

vectors.name: index-no-invitations
vectors.description: Without the "invitations" field (readers accept it; writers always write it).

vectors.name: index-updated-23h-ahead
vectors.description: updated 23 h after the reader's clock.

vectors.name: index-signed-by-master
vectors.description: Signed by the master key instead of the certified device.

vectors.name: index-unknown-entry-field
vectors.description: Unknown field in a pack entry without minor.

vectors.name: index-invalid-utf8
vectors.description: Bytes with an invalid UTF-8 sequence.

vectors.name: index-bom-bytes
vectors.description: UTF-8 BOM bytes EF BB BF before the text.

vectors.name: index-updated-25h-ahead
vectors.description: updated 25 h after the reader's clock.

vectors.name: index-updated-bad-date
vectors.description: updated is not a real instant.

vectors.name: index-file-mismatch
vectors.description: packs[].file does not match its hash.

vectors.name: index-duplicate-pack
vectors.description: The same hash listed twice (packs/ and media/).

vectors.name: index-pack-as-string
vectors.description: A pack entry given as a JSON string (V3-05).

vectors.name: index-invitations-bad-token
vectors.description: A token that is not "b2b256:" + 32 bytes.

vectors.name: index-invitations-3
vectors.description: 3 entries: readers do not require the writer's power-of-two padding.

vectors.name: index-implied-field
vectors.description: The compact sharing_cert carries "owner" (implied by the index).

vectors.name: index-revoked-list-tampered
vectors.description: Top-level revoked_devices changed (covered by the master signature of sharing_cert).

vectors.name: index-cert-no-location
vectors.description: A sharing certificate without read address cannot be in an index.

vectors.name: index-foreign-device-cert
vectors.description: device_cert is Bob's device (master signature over owner = Alice fails).

vectors.name: index-revoked-signer
vectors.description: Signed by d2 under the certificate that revokes d2.

vectors.name: index-stolen-device-tofu
vectors.description: RESIDUAL: d2 (later revoked) signs under the old certificate; a reader without anchor accepts it.

vectors.name: index-stolen-device-after-revocation
vectors.description: The same index for a reader who saw rotation 1.

vectors.name: index-fork-anchor
vectors.description: Fork detected through an anchor (hash of the canonical index).

vectors.name: index-moved-option
vectors.description: Read at another address than the certified one: MOVED to the certified address.

vectors.name: index-storage-move-redirect
vectors.description: Rotation 2 (storage move) read at the old address: redirect.

vectors.name: index-storage-move-new-address
vectors.description: Rotation 2 read at the new address.

vectors.name: index-move-detected
vectors.description: A reader expecting Alice finds the move: IDENTITY_MOVED (never accepted automatically).

vectors.name: index-move-followed
vectors.description: Following the move: expectedOwner = new, retiredOwners = [old].

vectors.name: index-move-conflict
vectors.description: A second, different successor of the retired identity: IDENTITY_MOVED with conflict.

vectors.name: index-move-wrong-target
vectors.description: A move to Alice-new embedded in Bob's index.

vectors.name: padding-one-open
vectors.description: inv1's token and 3 dummies (as in index-ok).

vectors.name: padding-three-days-later
vectors.description: No invitation, 3 days later: dummies whose epoch changed differ.
